Download prepared fertility rates from the Human Fertility Database

Source: R/construct_demographic_rates.R
get_fertility_hfd.Rd

Download total period age-specific fertility rates (asfrRR) through HMDHFDplus and select one year or a vector of years from one download. Rates remain births per woman-year. One year gives a static schedule without calendar columns; multiple years give chronological time_start/time_end bands [year, year + 1). Nonconsecutive years retain gaps. Birth-order-specific columns are not used by default. Missing total rates are rejected. These HFD products use their native annual, single-age layout; HMD-style shape options are not available. With by_parity = TRUE, request conditional age/parity rates (mi) instead: first births map to parity [0,1), through fifth-or-higher births at [4,Inf). Missing conditional cells are replaced with zero; source metadata records that policy and the number of replacements across the selected years. Parity tables can be supplied to fertility constructors for parity-dependent execution. Parity initializes from recorded maternal birth histories.

Usage

get_fertility_hfd(
  country,
  year,
  username = Sys.getenv("HFD_USERNAME"),
  password = Sys.getenv("HFD_PASSWORD"),
  update = NULL,
  by_parity = FALSE
)

Arguments

country

A single HFD population code.

year

One whole-number calendar year or a nonempty vector of distinct years. All requested years must exist; duplicates are rejected.

username

HFD username, defaulting to HFD_USERNAME.

password

HFD password, defaulting to HFD_PASSWORD.

update

Optional HFD revision date as "YYYYMMDD", passed as Update to HMDHFDplus. NULL requests its current revision.

by_parity

Logical, default FALSE. TRUE returns conditional rates with parity_start/parity_end in addition to the age bounds and rate. Requires the HFD conditional-rate product; unavailable products/years error rather than falling back to unconditional rates.

Value

A fertility rate tibble with a source attribute recording selected years and source periods. Multiple years include time_start/time_end; length-one requests omit them. Total-rate tables are validated for execution. Parity tables use half-open age/parity bounds; unavailable conditional rates are zero-filled.

Details

HFD endpoint rows are retained: 12- is represented as [12,13) using its supplied rate, and 55+ as [55,Inf). TFR omits the upper-open band and warns if its rate is nonzero. No rates are supplied outside the represented schedule. Credentials are never retained in the table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rates <- get_fertility_hfd("USA", 2000)
saveRDS(rates, "rates.rds")
model <- hammel_model() |> set_fertility(readRDS("rates.rds"))
history <- get_fertility_hfd("SWE", 1891:2000)
# Conditional age/parity rates for simulation:
parity_rates <- get_fertility_hfd("USA", 2000, by_parity = TRUE)
} # }
